paragraphs: From Mallow test centre, depart along Navigation Road and take your 1st right, still on Navigation Road
Continue ahead and then take the next left, following Navigation Road for roughly 1.5km
Take another left and stay with Navigation Road for a further 1.5km before you reach a quieter unnamed stretch
Keep your speed steady and check mirrors regularly on these longer straights
Carry on straight as the road becomes Quartertown Road for nearly 2km continue straight onto an unnamed road for a short distance
After roughly another kilometre, bear left to join the R620 and follow it for about 1km
Turn right onto Cork Road take your 1st right onto the L9045, and 1st right again into Gooldshill Housing Estate for a short residential section
Coming back out of the estate, take a slight right within Gooldshill, then at the end of the road turn left onto the L9045
Turn right onto Cork Road and follow it as it becomes Ballydaheen and then Bridge Street heading into Mallow town
Take extra care with pedestrians and parked cars along this built-up stretch
Turn right onto Spa Walk left onto Muddy Hill
At the end of the road turn right onto New Road
Left onto Fair Street, and take your 1st right onto Bowling Green
Continue left along Bowling Green turn right into Chapel Lane and left onto Mallow North Urban for a brief pull-in
Departing again take the right onto the unnamed road and complete a U-turn where directed
Take the next left, left again onto Chapel Lane, and left onto Rock Road
Follow Rock Road for about 270m, take a slight left
Left into Lacknalooha, and right onto Beecher Street
This section tests junction observation and low-speed control at the roundabout
Take the exit left onto New Road and follow it for around 500m
At the next roundabout take the exit onto Navigation Road and stay on it for roughly 2.5km as you head back toward the test centre
Turn left onto the unnamed access road, take one more left, and pull in on the right to finish the route back at Mallow
